question: Which of the following organisations was one of the co-organisers of the 14th Asian Fisheries and Aquaculture Forum (14AFAF) held from 12 to 15 February 2025 at Pusa Campus, New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Asian Fisheries Society Indian Branch (AFSIB)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **14th Asian Fisheries and Aquaculture Forum (14AFAF):** This forum is a significant international event focusing on fisheries and aquaculture, bringing experts, researchers, and policymakers together to discuss advancements, challenges, and sustainable practices in the sector.
 
• **Organizing Bodies:** The forum held in February 2025 at **Pusa Campus, New Delhi**, was co-organized by various organizations, with the **Asian Fisheries Society Indian Branch (AFSIB)** being one of the key contributors. *Hence, the correct answer is Asian Fisheries Society Indian Branch (AFSIB).*
 
• Other organizations mentioned in the options, such as the **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), and World Health Organization (WHO)**, are globally recognized bodies involved in environmental and health-related initiatives. However, they were not directly listed as co-organizers of this particular event. *Hence, options 1, 2, and 4 are incorrect.*
 
• **AFSIB:** The Asian Fisheries Society Indian Branch is an active body that promotes research, technology, and sustainable practices in fisheries and aquaculture in India. Its involvement in this forum highlights its dedication to enhancing the sector at both national and regional levels.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Asian Fisheries Society Indian Branch (AFSIB):**

 
 
• **Location:** AFSIB operates within India, aiming to promote the growth and development of fisheries and aquaculture in the country.
 
• **Functions:** The branch organizes conferences, workshops, and forums to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration among industry stakeholders, researchers, and policymakers.
 
• **Significance:** AFSIB plays a vital role in addressing challenges such as sustainable aquaculture practices, climate change impacts, and food security through collaboration and innovation.
 
 
 
• **14th Asian Fisheries and Aquaculture Forum:**
 
 
• **Date and Location:** Held from **12 to 15 February 2025** at **Pusa Campus, New Delhi**, it was a platform for discussing emerging trends and challenges in fisheries and aquaculture.
 
• **Theme:** Focused on sustainable development and innovative solutions to ensure food security and environmental conservation in the fisheries sector.
 
• **Participants:** The event saw participation from international organizations, experts, and policymakers, showcasing advancements in technology, policies, and practices.
 
 
 
• **Other Organizations:**
 
 
• **United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP):** An international body focusing on environmental issues, including climate change and biodiversity conservation. Although relevant to fisheries indirectly, UNEP was not a co-organizer of this event.
 
• **Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO):** A specialized UN agency that addresses food security and agriculture, including fisheries. FAO supports sustainable aquaculture practices but was not directly involved as a co-organizer in the 14AFAF.
 
• **World Health Organization (WHO):** Focuses primarily on global health-related issues and policies. While its work impacts fisheries indirectly through food safety and nutrition, it was not a co-organizer of this forum.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Fisheries and Aquaculture Forums:**

 
 
• These forums play a crucial role in addressing issues like **sustainable aquaculture, environmental conservation, food security, and economic development**.
 
• They encourage collaboration among stakeholders, including researchers, governments, and private organizations.
 
• Forums like the 14AFAF contribute to the formulation of policies and strategies for sustainable fisheries management.
 
 
 
• **India’s Role:**
 
 
• India is one of the largest producers of fish and aquaculture products globally, making platforms like 14AFAF highly significant for its economy and food security.
 
• Organizations like AFSIB play a key role in advancing research, technology, and practices to boost the sector's growth.
